name: Vespid Dynamics Pheromone Marker Gun PMG-1 'Breadwinner'
description: A pistol-format weapon that fires capsules of synthetic pheromone compound that mark a target with an invisible chemical signature detectable by Vespid's autonomous drone platforms. A target marked by the PMG-1 becomes a beacon — every Vespid drone within detection range will identify them as a designated target, enabling autonomous tracking and engagement. The pheromone compound bonds to clothing, skin, and hair, and cannot be washed off with standard solvents — it must be neutralized with a UV exposure protocol that itself takes 30 minutes of sustained treatment. The weapon does no damage itself; it simply paints a target for everything else in Vespid's arsenal.
specifications: capsule type: Synthetic pheromone marker compound effective range: 5-25 meters marking duration: 48 hours on skin, 72 hours on clothing detection range: Vespid drone platforms detect at 500+ meters neutralization: 30-minute UV exposure protocol magazine: 8 capsules weight: 0.7 kg compound visibility: Invisible to naked eye, fluoresces under UV
story_hooks: A player character has been marked with a PMG-1 pheromone compound and Vespid drones are converging on their location — they have 48 hours to find a UV neutralization source or go underground.

Someone has obtained PMG-1 compound and is spraying it on random people in crowded areas, triggering Vespid drone responses against innocent civilians — it is creating chaos and nobody knows who is doing it.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, insectoid-inspired pistol with an organic, almost chitinous aesthetic. The silhouette is elongated and tapered, resembling a wasp's abdomen in profile. Angular, predatory geometry dominates — sharp lines and narrow angles that suggest precision and menace rather than crude force.
physical_description.dimensions: 18.5 cm length, 4.2 cm width at grip, 5.8 cm height. Compact enough for one-handed operation, with a pronounced muzzle flare that suggests capsule ejection rather than traditional ballistics.
physical_description.weight_description: Surprisingly light — 0.7 kg feels almost toy-like in hand until the psychological weight of its function settles in. Perfectly balanced between thumb and fingers, with no felt recoil potential.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade polymer composite with carbon fiber reinforcement in the frame. The housing feels synthetic but rigid, designed for corporate precision manufacturing.
physical_description.finish: Satin gunmetal with a faint iridescent sheen — the surface catches light with subtle purple and green undertones, reminiscent of an insect's exoskeleton. Matte in recessed areas to reduce glare.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal grey primary with accent striping in bioluminescent violet along the slide and grip. The magazine well features warning markings in safety orange.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured polymer with hexagonal grip panels — organic but precise, designed to feel natural despite its alien purpose. Slightly cooler to the touch than ambient temperature.
distinctive_features: Flared muzzle designed for capsule dispersal rather than projectiles — wider opening suggests biological rather than kinetic purpose
Vespid Dynamics logo etched along the slide: a stylized wasp in aggressive posture
Magazine release modeled after an insect's mandible — hinged and organic-looking
Minimal iron sights; top-mounted rail for targeting assist optics or drone-link modules
Safety lever integrated into trigger guard with tactile detents
Faint capsule-count indicator window on magazine showing 8 positions
Integrated cooling vent pattern along the grip frame suggesting containment of chemical compounds
Serial plate stamped with Vespid's corporate identifier and restricted-use warning
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Large 'VESPID DYNAMICS' text along the slide in bold sans-serif. Smaller 'PMG-1 BREADWINNER' designation under the rail. Restricted-use warning stamps on frame. Corporate serial number on grip panel.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-maintained and pristine — a corporate tool kept in perfect working order. Evidence of regular use without visible wear; polymer shows no scuffs, finish unblemished. The weapon maintains an almost sterile appearance despite its sinister purpose.
